pages.text: The crucible refines essence without a GUI. Item crafting and enchanting no longer run here. Supply essence fluid, bottles or buckets. Empty-hand right-click retrieves products and returned containers. Automation cannot extract raw inputs.

Each 1000 mB batch produces ALL crystal types mapped to that essence, one each, using the element distilling fluid-to-crystal mappings, without needing leaves or mana powder. A batch takes 100 ticks and 1000 nearby pool mana. Full outputs prevent essence and mana consumption.

Capacity: 8000 mB of one essence. Pool range: 6 blocks horizontally, 2 vertically. Bottles supply 250 mB and return glass bottles; buckets supply 1000 mB and return buckets. Use the offering ritual for item crafting.
